display.purpose: Page titles and the Home lead: Archivo 700, uppercase, huge, with a 3px rule under it.

title.purpose: A title page or a person: Plex Sans Condensed 700.

heading.purpose: Section names and row titles: Plex Sans Condensed 700; uppercase for categories.

control.purpose: Buttons, chips, nav cells: Plex Mono 600, uppercase, .06em.

label.purpose: A section label above its list: red mono capitals, .12em.

meta.purpose: Facts under artwork: Plex Mono 12px, muted.

motion.name: nav-slide
motion.purpose: The top bar leaving on scroll down and returning on scroll up; none with reduced motion.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing, for every move.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: The loading ring; three seconds per turn with reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next action on a screen: Resume or Play. Solid ink.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Sits beside the primary, such as Details. Bordered, paper inside.

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: No border: icons and small actions. Hover fills blue.

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A bordered mono cell in a row of choices; current is inverted.

components.name: List Row
components.description: A full-width row with a red numeral and a condensed title; it inverts to blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;width:320px;padding:14px 12px;border-top:3px solid #0a0a0a;border-bottom:1px solid #0a0a0a;color:#0a0a0a;font:400 13px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace}.ds-row b{font:700 22px/1 "IBM Plex Sans Condensed",sans-serif;color:#d4140b}.ds-row span{flex:1;font:700 20px/1.1 "IBM Plex Sans Condensed",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-row i{font-style:normal}.ds-row:hover{background:#1a3dff;color:#fff}.ds-row:hover b{color:#fff}

components.name: Page Head
components.description: The giant Archivo title with the 3px rule under it.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: A blue logo cell, then 3px-bordered uppercase cells: current inverted, hover blue, a Light/Dark toggle at the end.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:stretch;width:100%;border-bottom:3px solid #0a0a0a;font:600 14px/1 "IBM Plex Mono",monospace;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}.ds-nav b{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 24px;min-height:56px;background:#1a3dff;color:#fff;font:700 24px/1 "IBM Plex Sans Condensed",sans-serif;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;border-right:3px solid #0a0a0a}.ds-nav i{flex:1}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 24px;border-left:3px solid #0a0a0a;color:#0a0a0a}.ds-nav a:hover{background:#1a3dff;color:#fff}.ds-nav .ds-current{background:#0a0a0a;color:#fff}

components.name: Empty State
components.description: A condensed headline, one serif sentence on what to do, an action.
components.html:
Nothing Watched Yet

Titles you finish appear here, newest first.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Index"**

Flow for the web is an index of what the viewer owns, set like a printed index made brutal: paper ruled in 3px ink lines, one giant word to open each page, everything below in rows and cells. Both light and dark are first-class. Red marks, blue acts, and nothing is soft: no radius, shadow, blur or gradient outside the video player.
keyCharacteristics: Paper #ffffff and ink #0a0a0a (dark: ink ground, #f2f2ee text); one red for markers and one blue for action.
3px ink rules divide the page; 1px lines divide rows; cells share borders.
Archivo for the giant title, Plex Sans Condensed for headings, Plex Mono for the interface, Plex Serif for reading.
Hover is a blue fill, current is inverted ink, focus is a 3px blue ring.
Every radius is 0 outside the player.
Artwork is the colour: square, framed by rules, with facts as mono text beneath.
The player is a conventional dark player with the system faces and square panels.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Red marks, blue acts. A screen has no third colour besides artwork; if something is both, it is blue.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: The current place and every hover are shown by swapping colours, never by tint, glow, shadow or underline weight.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every text pair is AA in both themes; red and blue are checked on paper, on ink and on each other's fills.

rules.name: The Mono Is the Interface Rule
rules.body: What you press, and every label and number, is mono. Sentences are serif. Headings are condensed. Only the giant title is Archivo.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Times, durations, sizes, ratings and counts use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Rule Is the Divider Rule
rules.body: Separate things with a line, not space or a fill: 3px to open a section, 1px between its items.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, backdrop-filter, gradient or radius outside the player.

dos: **Do** open every page with the giant Archivo title and its 3px rule.
**Do** divide with rules: 3px to open a block, 1px between rows.
**Do** show hover by a blue fill and the current place by inverted ink.
**Do** keep both themes AA, and check red and blue on both grounds.
**Do** set sentences in Plex Serif and everything you press in Plex Mono.
**Do** keep targets at 44px or more and a 3px blue focus ring on everything focusable.
**Do** keep artwork square and framed, with its facts as mono text beneath.
**Do** use the tokens (--bg --fg --red --blue --onblue --muted --faint --rule) and let data-theme do the rest.
donts: **Don't** round a corner or add a shadow, blur, gradient or glass outside the player.
**Don't** use red or blue as decoration: red marks, blue acts.
**Don't** put a pill, badge or kicker on content; labels are red mono text.
**Don't** hard-code a colour or a font; use the tokens so both themes and the player's dark scope follow.
**Don't** colour the current chip or tab blue: current is inverted ink.
**Don't** use a second accent, an icon container or a filled, rounded card.
**Don't** copy the reference's words, name, logo or images.
